$comment-baseline: Without a builtin-baseline, vcpkg resolves every dependency against
whatever commit the local vcpkg clone happens to sit on. Two machines
then get two different EnTT or Bullet, and a wheel that builds here fails
there. Pin it once, from the repo root, with:
which writes a builtin-baseline field next to this one.
